svg.title: Verify what “passed” means.
svg.desc: The same TypeScript candidate has implicit-any parameters and strict:true with noCheck:true. A compiler using candidate settings returns zero diagnostics and exit 0. A checker with independently fixed options and source files reports two type errors and exit 2. Approval is refused and the ref stays unchanged. A valid approval must bind the base, exact candidate and evidence digest. This local experiment does not establish authenticated approval, deployment or exactly-once execution.
